title: Project Atom in Serpo matches TTSA's Atom project

tellings.quote: And Project Atom is a um Los Alamos uh secret program that studies nuclear radiation and the radiation properties of materials recovered from extraterrestrial or alien spacecraft.

plain: A secret program called Project Atom is said to have run at Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, studying nuclear radiation and the radiation properties of materials taken from crashed alien spacecraft. A researcher named Deep Prasad describes it this way and draws the name from the Project Serpo papers, an account that circulated online about a supposed exchange of people between the United States and an alien world. He links it to a project of the same name around 2013 to 2016 tied to the musician Tom DeLonge and the physicist Hal Puthoff, which, if the match holds, would suggest the Serpo story and their work point to the same real program.
